items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise; Microsoft, Meta Lead Big Earnings After Market Tumbles, Oil Prices Soar
items.summary: Dow Jones futures rose early Thursday, along with S&P 500 futures and especially Nasdaq futures. Microsoft, Meta Platforms, Starbucks and Fortinet headlined another big night of earnings. Amazon and Apple will report after the close.

items.title: Datadog, IBD Stock Of The Day, Rides AI Momentum Ahead Of Earnings Report
items.summary: Datadog stock has surged over 85% in 2026, amid high, artificial intelligence-driven expectations ahead of the software maker's Q2 earnings.

items.title: DDOG's Multi-Year Contracts Grow: Is Revenue Growth More Predictable?
items.summary: Datadog's rising mix of multi-year contracts lifts RPO 51% to $3.48 billion, improving revenue visibility and supporting a higher 2026 outlook.

items.title: 3 Reasons We Love Datadog (DDOG)
items.summary: Datadog has been on fire lately. In the past six months alone, the company’s stock price has rocketed 79.7%, reaching $252.65 per share. This was partly thanks to its solid quarterly results, and the run-up might have investors contemplating their next move.

items.title: What Does the Datadog CEO's Sale of Company Shares Worth $11.5 Million Mean for Investors?
items.summary: The provider of an AI-powered observability and security platform reported a notable insider sale.

items.title: Datadog Director Amit Agarwal Sells 20,000 Shares for $5.2 Million
items.summary: Insider exercised stock options and sold shares under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan established in March, reducing his equity stake by 35% while retaining nearly 900,000 derivative securities.
